answer: Cosignatures are collected in quartz, verified in sable, and vertex names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 16 submissions per epoch. A 497 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
